name: Make friendship bracelets
blurb: Two knots — forward and backward — produce every classic pattern. It is a portable, cheap craft with quick visible results.
gear: Tape or a clipboard to anchor the work
steps: Learn the forward knot and the backward knot. Every pattern is a sequence of these two.
Make a candy-stripe bracelet: all forward knots, which teaches consistent tension.
Make a chevron, which introduces working from both sides towards the middle.
Learn to read a pattern chart, where each cell tells you which knot to tie.
Learn tension control — the most common beginner problem is knots that vary in tightness and make the bracelet curl.
Learn to finish with a braid and a loop, or a sliding knot closure.
tips: Anchor the work firmly. Loose anchoring is why tension wanders.
Cut the strands much longer than seems necessary — about four times the finished length per strand.
proof: Three bracelets in different patterns, with even tension and a proper closure.
